items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Send us a message. We'll set up a short call to understand your business and see if we're a good fit.

items.question: Can I hire you for just one thing?
items.answer: Yes. A website, ads or anything else on its own is fine.

items.question: How is pricing set?
items.answer: Per project, based on scope. You get a clear proposal before any work starts.

items.question: Do you work remotely?
items.answer: Yes. We work with clients across Europe and Latin America, fully remote.

items.question: Who owns the website and data?
items.answer: Your domain, content and customer data are always yours. We host and maintain the site for you, so you don't have to deal with the technical side.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data we collect through this website, why we collect it, and what rights you have.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
paragraphs: Brehaut Consulting is the data controller for the processing described here. If you have questions about your personal data, email contact@brehautconsulting.com.

sections.heading: The contact form
paragraphs: When you send the contact form we receive your name, email address, phone number, company, website (if you add it), the services you select and your message.

We use this only to reply to your enquiry and, if we decide to work together, to prepare a proposal. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.

The form is delivered to our inbox as an email through Amazon Web Services (Amazon SES). It is not stored in a database on the website. We keep the correspondence as long as needed to handle your enquiry. If it does not lead to an assignment, we delete it within 12 months.

sections.heading: Spam protection
paragraphs: To stop automated spam, the form limits how many messages can be sent in a short time. For this we store a one-way hashed (pseudonymised) version of your IP address for at most 24 hours. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in keeping the form secure.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The website works without cookies. Only if you accept in the cookie banner do we load Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics, which set cookies to measure visits, for example which pages are viewed and whether the contact form is sent. If you decline, nothing is loaded. The legal basis is your consent.
Your choice is saved in your browser so we don't ask again. You can change it at any time via "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page.

sections.heading: Hosting
paragraphs: The website is hosted by Netlify. Like any web server, Netlify processes technical data such as your IP address and browser type to deliver the pages and protect against attacks.

sections.heading: Who we share data with
paragraphs: We only share personal data with service providers that process it on our behalf: Netlify (hosting), Amazon Web Services (email delivery), our email provider and, only with your consent, Google (analytics). We never sell personal data.
Some of these providers are based in the USA. Such transfers are protected by the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, to restrict or object to its processing, to data portability, and to withdraw your consent at any time. Email contact@brehautconsulting.com and we will reply within one month.
If you think we handle your data incorrectly, you can complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY) at imy.se.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
